title: Tectonic Plate Subduction & Earthquake Propagation
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates tectonic plate subduction and earthquake propagation in a cross-sectional 3D view.

## Scene Setup
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 30, 60), looking at origin. OrbitControls enabled.
- Lighting: One DirectionalLight at (10, 40, 20) intensity 1.2, one AmbientLight intensity 0.35, one HemisphereLight(0x87ceeb, 0x553311, 0.3).
- Background: dark gradient sky color 0x0a0a1a.
- Ground plane: a large flat plane at y=-1 with dark ocean-floor material.

## Tectonic Plates
- Create two tectonic plates as subdivided BoxGeometry slabs (width 40, height 3, depth 30, widthSegments 20, depthSegments 15).
- OCEANIC plate (left, blue-gray 0x4a6a7a) starts at x=-22. CONTINENTAL plate (right, brown-tan 0x8B7355) starts at x=18.
- Each plate's geometry vertices can be deformed. Store original vertex positions.
- The oceanic plate slowly subducts (moves right and downward at the contact zone) beneath the continental plate.
- Subduction angle: approximately 30 degrees from horizontal.
- Mantle layer: a semi-transparent orange-red box beneath both plates at y=-8, representing the asthenosphere.

## Physics & Simulation
- Maintain a simulation clock (simTime in seconds, advances by dt=0.016 per frame when running).
- STRESS ACCUMULATION: At the subduction zone (where plates overlap around x=-2 to x=2), stress accumulates linearly over time: stress += stressRate * dt. stressRate = 1.0 per second. Max stress = 100.
- EARTHQUAKE TRIGGER: When stress >= earthquakeThreshold (default 50), an earthquake is triggered. Stress resets to 0. The earthquake has a magnitude = 4.0 + (stress_at_trigger / 100) * 5.0 (so range 4.0-9.0).
- ENERGY: Each earthquake releases energy = 10^(1.5 * magnitude + 4.8) in joules (Gutenberg-Richter). Track totalEnergyReleased as cumulative sum.
- SEISMIC WAVE PROPAGATION: When an earthquake triggers, spawn a seismic wave ring (RingGeometry) at the epicenter (x=0, y=0, z=0). The ring expands outward at waveSpeed = 15 units/sec. Max radius = 80. Fade opacity from 1.0 to 0.0 as it expands. Support up to 5 simultaneous wave rings.
- PLATE DEFORMATION: During an earthquake, vertices near the epicenter are displaced vertically by random amounts proportional to magnitude * 0.1, decaying with distance. Vertices slowly relax back to original positions at rate 0.5 per second after the quake.
- SUBDUCTION VELOCITY: oceanic plate moves at baseVelocity = 0.5 units/sec rightward and 0.25 units/sec downward. When paused, velocity = 0.

## User Interactions
- SPACEBAR: Toggle simulation pause/resume.
- UP/DOWN Arrow keys: Adjust earthquakeThreshold by +/-5 (clamp 10 to 100).
- LEFT/RIGHT Arrow keys: Adjust stressRate by +/-0.2 (clamp 0.2 to 5.0).
- Click on a plate (raycasting): Select it, highlight with emissive color. Display plate info in HUD.
- DOM button 'Force Quake' (id='forceQuakeBtn'): Immediately trigger an earthquake at current stress level (even if below threshold). Stress resets to 0.
- DOM button 'Reset Sim' (id='resetSimBtn'): Reset all state to initial values. Plates return to starting positions, stress=0, all waves cleared, counters reset.
- DOM button 'Undo Last Quake' (id='undoQuakeBtn'): Revert the last earthquake: restore stress to pre-quake value, decrement quakeCount, subtract last energy from total. Only works once (for the most recent quake). Disabled if no quakes have occurred.
- Keyboard 'W': Toggle wireframe mode on plates.
- Keyboard 'H': Toggle heatmap overlay on mantle (color shifts from orange to bright red based on proximity to subduction zone).

## HUD / UI
- Top-left overlay div (id='hud') showing:
  - Stress: XX.X / threshold (with color bar, green->yellow->red)
  - Quake Count: N
  - Last Magnitude: X.XX
  - Total Energy: X.XXe+YY J
  - Sim Time: XX.Xs
  - Plate Velocity: X.X u/s
  - Selected Plate: name or 'None'
  - Stress Rate: X.X /s
  - Threshold: XX
  - Paused: Yes/No
- Three buttons at bottom: 'Force Quake', 'Reset Sim', 'Undo Last Quake'.

## State Management (CRITICAL)
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
{
  simTime: number,
  paused: boolean,
  stress: number,
  stressRate: number,
  earthquakeThreshold: number,
  quakeCount: number,
  lastMagnitude: number,
  totalEnergyReleased: number,
  lastEnergyReleased: number,
  activeWaves: number,
  oceanicPlateX: number,
  oceanicPlateY: number,
  continentalPlateX: number,
  wireframeOn: boolean,
  heatmapOn: boolean,
  selectedPlate: string ('oceanic'|'continental'|'none'),
  plateVelocity: number,
  vertexDisplacementMax: number,
  undoAvailable: boolean,
  preQuakeStress: number,
  sceneReady: boolean
}

Ensure sceneReady = true after all meshes are created and first render completes.
physics_constraints: Stress accumulates linearly at stressRate per second. Earthquake triggers at threshold with magnitude = 4.0 + (stress/100)*5.0. Energy follows Gutenberg-Richter: E = 10^(1.5*mag + 4.8). Seismic waves propagate at 15 u/s. Plate subduction at 0.5 u/s horizontal, 0.25 u/s vertical. Vertex deformation decays with distance from epicenter. Conservation: totalEnergyReleased must equal cumulative sum of all individual earthquake energies.
